notes.title: Ver.0.4.0 Released! Added screenshot feature
notes.content:
[h3]Additions/Changes[/h3]

[list]

[*] Added screenshot button
[list]
[*] Displayed by turning on “Display screenshot button” in the settings screen.
[*] The screenshot can be taken with some UI hidden.
[/list][*] Added/Changed recommended rule settings
[list]
[*] Divided “for 2-5 persons” into “for 3 persons” and “for 4-5 persons”.
[*] Changed the amount of “Gun” which the Werewolves initially own. (2 → 1)
[/list][*] Added “Apply Recommended Rule Setting Button” to the rule settings screen
[*] Added a feature to copy chats in the room
[list]
[*] Clicking on a message copies it to the clipboard.
[*] Use this for Google Translate or something!
[/list][*] Added/Changed How-to-Play/Tutorial
[list]
[*] Added the item of “Megaphone”.
[*] Added the item of “Smoke Grenade”.
[*] Changed the item of “Disguise”. (Added descriptions of scapegoat tactics)
[*] Improved various tutorial flows.
[/list][*] Changed some UIs
[list]
[*] Fixed some translations.
[*] Adjusted UIs of room creation (to improve visibility)
[*] Added notification when you kicked out of the room
[*] Updated the Staff Credit (Implemented Oshi roulette)
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Ver.0.3.1 Released! Dedicated to all those who couldn't afford Switch 2
notes.content:
FYI, I won the 3rd lottery ✌️

[h3]Additions/Changes[/h3]

[list] 
[*] Added item “Smoke Grenade” 
[list] [*] Can disperse Townsfolks by taking away the vision of players other than yourself.
[*] This can make it easier to kill a player who is confirmed as a Townsfolk, and to disguise as it ...hopefully. 
[/list][*] Added the ability to kick & ban players in a room 
[list] 
[*] Click on a player's name > click the “Kick” button to kick & ban the player.
[*] Kicking is only available for the room creator.
[*] Banned players will not be able to enter rooms you create anymore.
[*] To remove a ban, go to “BANNED PLAYER LIST” in the menu and click the trash button.
[/list][*] Changed “Marauder's Map” to a consumable item
[list] 
[*] After use it, the position of all players will be displayed on the map permanently.
[*] Intended to increase the space in your inventory.
[/list][*] Adjusted the “Recommended” rule settings 
[list] 
[*] Changed craftable items (Knife → Gun)
[*] Changed number of “Gun” in the initial inventory settings (1 → 2)
[*] Changed number of “Time Bomb” in the initial inventory settings (total 8 → total 6)
[*] Changed the cooldown time of Knife and Gun (30 seconds → 60 seconds)
[*] Changed the number of materials needed to repair the workbench (20 → 10)
[/list][*] Adjusted the duration of the Team Announcement screen
[list]
[*] Reduced the time (8 seconds → 6 seconds) if “Display of Overhead Marker” is set to “Distinguish Fellow Werewolves” in the rules settings.
[/list][*] Added preview display when the cursor is on a “Embodied Scribble” in inventory 
[*] Adjusted the physical behavior of the item “Embodied Scribble” to be more natural.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

Fixed the following bugs.

[list]
[*] Under certain conditions, rooms that should be displayed in the “Play with Someone” list may not be displayed.
[list]
[*] If the time on the room creator's PC is more than one hour before the searcher's PC, the room will not be displayed in search results.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Ver.0.2.0 Released! Added new item “Gun” for peace
notes.content:
[h3]Additions/Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added item “Gun”.
[list]
[*] Consumable item version of “Knife”.
[*] When used in conjunction with the “Knife”, the “Gun” can be used to attack the injured player by yourself (but for a limited number of times).
[*] Preserving it until late in the game can help Werewolf to overcome the disadvantage of being alone.
[*] This can make it easier to kill a player who is confirmed as a Townsfolk, and to disguise as it ...hopefully.
[/list][*] Added a spawn point of workbench.
[list]
[*] To respond to the addition of “Gun”
[/list][*] Added “Max Concurrent Time Bombs” setting to the rule settings.
[list]
[*] Limits the number of Time Bombs that can appear at the same time.
[*] To prevent too many consecutive Time Bomb use in “Recommended (2P - 5P)” rule setting.
(This rule limits it to “2”.)
[/list][*] Adjusted the “Recommended” rule settings.
[list]
[*] Changed the cooldown time of “Time Bombs” from 30 seconds to 40 seconds (except for 2P - 5P setting).
[*] Added “Gun (x1)” to the initial inventory.
[/list][*] Added some cameraworks at the beginning of the game.
[list]
[*] So that the Werewolves can glance over all characters to make it easier to find a target to disguise as.
[/list][*] Added a heartbeat as a countdown to death when injured.
[list]
[*] Heartbeat sounds 10 seconds before death.
[*] Also, added a countdown effect to the remaining time gauge on the drawing screen.
[/list][*] Adjusted the amount of light after “Landmine” activation.
[list]
[*] The light was too bright and it was too obvious that they had been placed there.
[/list][*] Added “Quit Application” button to the title screen menu
[*] Added notification when there is an update while the game is running.
[list]
[*] Displayed when exiting a room, etc.
[/list][*] Adjusted some other UIs.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

Fixed the following bugs.

[list]
[*] App freezes when pressing “Start Tutorial” button with new save data.
[list]
[*] Seriously sorry bro.
[*] Seems to have recurred since Ver.0.1.4 (but it was caused by a completely different reason than before. For real?)
[/list][*] In some cases, the character creation screen did not move to the next screen even after the time limit was reached.
[list]
[*] Some parts were not fully addressed in Ver.0.1.4.
[/list][*] Chat sound effects of dead players can be heard by live players.
[*] Some logs of “Time Bomb” use remain in the “Last Game Record”.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver.0.1.4 Released! Recommend / copy and paste function for rule setting, etc
notes.content:
[h3]Add/Change[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added “Recommend” feature for rule settings.
[list]
[*] Added “Rule Setting Type” in the “Create Room” / “Room” screen.
[/list][*] Added copy/paste function for rule settings.
[list]
[*] Copy/paste to/from clipboard.
[*] Paste to SNS, etc. to share with others.
[/list][*] Added “Distinguish Fellow Werewolves” setting to “Display of Overhead Marker” in the rules settings.
[list]
[*] From the werewolf's point of view, the color of the marker can be used to distinguish the teams.
[*] Adjusted the basic marker color accordingly.
[/list][*] Added a cursor display for the editing tool on the drawing screen.
[list]
[*] Countermeasure against accidental flood fill when trying to draw a line
[*] Can be turned on/off in the settings.
[/list][*] Added a countdown before the game starts.
[*] Added support for inputting full-width alphabets, symbols, and other characters.
[*] Removed “Time Bomb” usage log from “Last Game Records”.
[list]
[*] This information was not that important, but it was making it difficult to see the record.
[/list][*] Adjusted field terrain.
[list]
[*] Adjusted to make it easier to get from the hat to the record player.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

Fixed the following bugs.

[list]
[*] Scrolling behavior of “Last Game Record” was not correct.
[*] On the side of a player who joined a room just after the game started, the display did not show the completed state even if the “Done!” button is pressed.
[/list]
